# The RealWorld apps call a dead backend; the project now hosts api.realworld.show

## Context

Ada's defect-note (10-20 08:57Z): both RealWorld apps boot with no articles and throw page errors. Re-probed 2026-10-20 ~09:05Z:

| app | `API_URL` | answer |
|---|---|---|
| `apps/realworld` | `https://api.realworld.io/api` | HTTP 530 (Cloudflare 1016) |
| `apps/realworld2` | `https://conduit.productionready.io/api` | 307 → `api.realworld.io` → 530 |

The RealWorld project moved to the `realworld-apps` org. Its README now names *"a hosted version of the backend API available for public usage at api.realworld.show, no API keys required — demo accounts are provided"*. `https://api.realworld.show/api/articles` and `/api/tags` answer 200 with spec-shaped JSON.

## The Problem

Both apps are among Neo's oldest. They follow the Conduit templates 1:1, so they use containers and custom-vdom components, not the component library. They depend entirely on an external backend, and that backend's old host is gone. The 13.3 notes credit #19700 with "Both RealWorld apps boot again". That is true, but a reader who opens them sees an empty feed.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/realworld/api/config.mjs` and `apps/realworld2/api/config.mjs` each export one `API_URL` constant; every API call derives from it.
- The last endpoint move was `34585fae92` (2021-10-28).

## The Fix

Point both `API_URL` constants at `https://api.realworld.show/api`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Both `config.mjs` files name `https://api.realworld.show/api`.
- [ ] In a browser, each app's home feed lists articles and tags from the hosted API, and no request to the dead hosts (CORS redirect, `reading 'json'` TypeErrors) remains.

## Out of Scope

- The dead default avatar (`static.productionready.io/images/smiley-cyrus.jpg`, 404) in `CreateCommentComponent`. Upstream now specifies its own `default-avatar.svg`; a separate cosmetic fix.
- The API layer throwing unhandled TypeErrors when the backend is down (the rest of Ada's note): error handling, separate.
- Re-checking the apps against the current upstream templates.
- `apps/realworld2` rendering its home view twice and throwing `reading 'subscribe'` on load. Both happen on dev's URLs too, independent of the backend (defect-note 2026-10-20 09:17Z).

## Related

- #19700 (the boot fix). `#19784` (13.3 notes; its RealWorld bound drops once this merges).
